display.purpose: Every PageHeader h1 and hero headlines; Fraunces light, tight tracking, never bold.

body.purpose: All prose, tables, forms; Geist default sans.

eyebrow.purpose: The small uppercase pill above hero headlines.

shadows.name: elevation-soft
shadows.purpose: Resting surfaces: cards, tables, outline buttons. Warm-tinted paper-on-paper depth with a top inner highlight.

shadows.name: elevation-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating surfaces: dialogs, sheets, the app sheet. The same paper edge, lifted.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: The edge idiom: ring-1 ring-foreground/[0.06] instead of a border on every card and tray.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: The default easing for all transitions; 300ms default duration. Never ease-linear or ease-in-out.

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Page entrance: opacity 0→1, translateY 1rem→0, blur 6px→0. Page-level sections only, never table rows or list items.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one accent voice: sage-emerald pill with an inset paper-edge highlight.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="16" height="16"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg>Save changes</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); transition: background-color 300ms var(--ease-spring, cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)), transform 300ms var(--ease-spring, cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Resting paper pill for secondary actions; lifts to muted on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7), 0 1px 2px rgb(60 40 20 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px -16px rgb(60 40 20 / 0.12); transition: background-color 300ms var(--ease-spring, cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Hairline-bordered rounded field; focus shifts the border to the green ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.25rem; width: 100%; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 300ms var(--ease-spring, cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)), box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-spring, cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Translucent glass resting surface: soft shadow, hairline ring, no border.
components.html:
Checking account
Everyday spending and transfers.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 1.35rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7), 0 1px 2px rgb(60 40 20 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px -16px rgb(60 40 20 / 0.12); outline: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 6%, transparent); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Eyebrow Tag
components.description: The small uppercase pill above a hero headline.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: BrandMark
components.description: The signature logo tile: house glyph in a machined double-bezel tray.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 3px; border-radius: 0.8rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); } .ds-brand-core { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: calc(0.8rem - 3px); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Pill nav item on the glass sidebar tray; active state fills with accent tint.
components.html: TransactionsAccountsGoals
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 180px; padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: 1.35rem; background: var(--sidebar); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7), 0 1px 2px rgb(60 40 20 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px -16px rgb(60 40 20 / 0.12); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--sidebar-foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms var(--ease-spring, cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 4%, transparent); } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 12%, transparent); color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Dialog Panel
components.description: The lifted floating surface: larger radius, lift shadow, hairline edge.
components.html:
Delete transaction?
This moves it to the trash. You can restore it for 30 days.
components.css: .ds-dialog { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; width: 22rem; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 1.65rem; background: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7), 0 2px 6px rgb(60 40 20 / 0.05), 0 32px 64px -24px rgb(60 40 20 / 0.22); outline: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 6%, transparent); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-dialog-title { font-family: 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-dialog-body { font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.25rem; } .ds-dialog-actions .ds-btn-outline, .ds-dialog-actions .ds-btn-primary { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 0.875rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 300ms var(--ease-spring, cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)); } .ds-dialog-actions .ds-btn-outline { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-dialog-actions .ds-btn-primary { border: none; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); }

narrative.overview: OpenHouse renders money the way a careful bookkeeper keeps a ledger: on warm paper, in espresso ink, with one quiet green accent that behaves like the seal on an envelope — present, meaningful, never loud. The app world is editorial warm: a cream canvas carries translucent glass cards that float over a fixed ambient mesh, serif headlines in Fraunces set the tone, and Geist does the working. Depth reads as layered paper plus glass: warm-tinted diffuse shadows with a top inner highlight, translucent surfaces refracting a fixed ambient glow. The landing page runs a deliberate sister world — warm monochrome with Newsreader and meaning-only washes — sharing the paper temperament but not the palette.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper and espresso ink; one muted sage-emerald voice
Translucent glass surfaces over a fixed ambient mesh, with fixed paper grain
Fraunces (light serif) headlines; Geist body and data
Two-tier shadow vocabulary: soft at rest, lift when floating
Spring motion, 300 ms, transform and opacity only

rules.name: The Semantic Only Rule
rules.body: No hex, no oklch(...), no Tailwind palette colors in feature code — only the semantic classes. Charts use --chart-1…5. The values live in globals.css alone.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Color carries meaning or it does not appear: the four washes are reserved for tags and icon wells that encode state.

rules.name: The Never-Bold Rule
rules.body: Serif headings never take font-bold — font-light or font-normal and tracking-tight only. Body stays the default sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Money and number columns stay tabular; tables get font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums automatically — never break it.

rules.name: The No Grey Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never shadow-md/lg/xl or dark rgba shadows — only shadow-soft / shadow-lift, paired with ring-1 ring-foreground/[0.06] instead of a border.

rules.name: The Sticky Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-blur lives only on sticky or fixed elements (header, overlays) — never on scrolling content.

dos: Do use semantic token classes only; add a missing token to globals.css (both themes) and document it here first.
Do keep radii concentric when nesting (tray 2rem → core calc(2rem-0.375rem)).
Do animate only transform and opacity, on the spring curve (ease-spring or inherited 300 ms default).
Do check .dark before finishing — every surface ships in both themes.
Do route all new user-facing copy through locales/en-US.json (packages/ui components stay label-agnostic).
Do render lucide icons at the global 1.5 stroke; never pass strokeWidth.
donts: Don't use hex, oklch literals, or Tailwind palette colors in feature code.
Don't set font-bold on serif headings.
Don't use shadow-md/lg/xl, dark rgba shadows, or border where the hairline ring is the idiom.
Don't use ease-linear, ease-in-out, or bare transition-all.
Don't put backdrop-blur on scrolling content.
Don't add new z-layers beyond sticky z-10 and overlays z-50.
Don't use the double bezel or ambient glow more than once per page — one focal element.
Don't animate table rows or list items; page-level sections may use animate-page-in.
Don't mix the landing's monochrome world into app screens, or the app's green into landing pages — each world keeps its own accent economy.
